name: I Am Sober
one_liner: I Am Sober is a sobriety tracking app that helps you track your alcohol-free or substance-free days, celebrate milestones, and stay motivated with daily pledges and a supportive community.
best_for: People in early recovery who benefit from daily motivation and tracking
Those who want to track sobriety milestones and see their progress
People who find community support helpful in maintaining sobriety
Those cutting back on alcohol or substances who want accountability
People who respond well to gamification and achievement tracking
not_for: Those needing medical detox or supervised withdrawal
People with severe addiction requiring comprehensive treatment programs
Those seeking professional therapy or counseling through the app
short_description: Sobriety tracking app with milestone celebrations, daily pledges, and community support for addiction recovery.
long_description: I Am Sober helps you track your sobriety journey with a clean, motivating interface. The app counts your sober days, hours, and minutes, and celebrates milestones with you. Each morning, you take a pledge to stay sober for the day, and each night, you mark whether you kept it. The app includes a community feature where you can connect with others in recovery, share your story, and offer support. It also tracks money saved and time reclaimed from your addiction.
patient_summary: I Am Sober is like having a sober companion in your pocket. Every day, you make a pledge to stay sober, track your progress, and celebrate milestones. Connect with others in recovery for support when you need it.

pricing.notes: Free version includes core tracking and community. Premium adds advanced analytics and features.

privacy.notes: Account required for community features. Anonymous username option available.

faqs.q: Is I Am Sober effective for staying sober?
faqs.a: Many users find the daily pledge system and milestone tracking helpful for maintaining motivation in recovery. The app is a support tool, not a treatment. It works best as part of a broader recovery plan that may include therapy, support groups, or other treatment.

faqs.q: What can I track with I Am Sober?
faqs.a: You can track sobriety from any substance or behavior including alcohol, drugs, smoking, gambling, or anything else. The app counts your sober time, money saved, milestones reached, and includes a journal for reflection.

faqs.q: Is the I Am Sober community anonymous?
faqs.a: Yes. You can choose any username and don't need to share identifying information. The community is moderated and focused on support and encouragement.

faqs.q: Can I Am Sober replace AA or treatment?
faqs.a: I Am Sober is a supplementary tool, not a replacement for treatment, therapy, or support groups like AA. It works well alongside these other supports to provide daily motivation and tracking.
